name: gi-spain-tax-residence
description: Assess Gibraltar–Spain tax-residence conflicts under the 2019 agreement in force from March 2021, using individual overnight, family, home and asset tests, relocation rules and entity residence triggers. Covers historical corporate exceptions, evidence needs, domestic double-tax relief and administrative cooperation. Use for a move between Spain and Gibraltar, a cross-border worker, or a Gibraltar entity with Spanish management, owners, assets or income. Includes conditional arithmetic checks and separates treaty rules from official guidance discrepancies. This source-cited draft does not compute Spanish tax, certify historic exception eligibility or replace domestic residence and filing analysis. Independent review remains pending.
